_documentation: Example host.json for a dedicated Windows NUC fed by a separate game PC. Copy to host.json next to nullCAT.exe and edit nicName + the IPs. See Docs/NUC_DEPLOYMENT.md and host.reference.json. rig.json (axes + tuning) is edited in the web UI -- copy it from a known-good rig.
_section_nuc: The two NUC-defining choices: nicName = the EtherCAT NIC SOEM opens raw; telemetryBindAddr = 0.0.0.0 (or the link NIC IP) so telemetry from the GAME PC is received, not just loopback.
nicName: CHANGE-ME: EtherCAT NIC name (e.g. Intel(R) I211 Gigabit Network Connection)
_section_web: Operate/configure from the game PC's browser. webBindAddr 0.0.0.0 exposes the UI on the network; there is no login (trusted-LAN model, see KNOWN_LIMITATIONS security section), so keep the link point-to-point or on a trusted private network. The Host-header allowlist and the local-clients-only power gate are always enforced.
_comment_dcSyncOffsetNs: 500000 (500us) is the WINDOWS setting -- Windows builds run this offset to ride out scheduler jitter. Pi builds run 0.
